items.title: Ramsey Lewis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Daddy-O introduced us to Phil and Leonard Chess... Daddy-O advised us... Our business relationship was healthy, because of what went on before us.

ctx.x: Yeah, nightclubs. London House, Kelly’s, many places to play. But we ended up playing at Stelzer’s. Stelzer’s was a restaurant on this side, bar on this side, and in the bar, they had music. They hired us to be a trio. While we were there, Daddy-O heard us again. He said, “You guys are pretty good.” “Thank you.” He says, “You should make a record.” He introduced us to Phil and Leonard Chess. I’m trying to – I think by now Redd is out of the army, because he’s on that first album. Also, we’re playing 4, 5, 6…
auditioned us and eventually we made our first album, that things began to get much better.
